title: Countdown Beeps
blurb: Three short, one long, and something is about to happen. The cadence has gone genuinely universal: rocket launches, match starts, ring timers, the microwave conducting psychological warfare from the kitchen. It works because the final long tone is unambiguous. The counting has stopped and the event has begun. Editors use it to build tension before a reveal; streamers run it before a match. Synthesised cleanly at a frequency that cuts through any mix without needing to be loud. Free MP3 download, no launch pad required.
origin: Original synthesis of the standard 3-short-1-long countdown cadence.
